title: 第一卷 第8章 收获满满
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
“噗通！”

    陆川再次跳进海河中。

    因为带了水鬼珠的原因，他只感觉自己好似水中的鱼儿。

    别说憋气，就连有用速度也快的惊人。

    没一会，就潜到水底深处。

    在一番搜寻后，很快就找到水鬼头领的尸体。

    就在陆川准备将水鬼头领的尸体捞回岸上的时候，无意间发现远处水底有一抹淡淡的光晕。

    他好奇地游过去一看，发现是一个洞穴。

    洞穴宽大，上面还有不少抓痕和水鬼特有的鳞片。

    难不成这里就是水鬼们的老窝？

    陆川心中顿时警惕起来。

    好在并未在洞中发现水鬼的身影。

    想来应该是陆川将水鬼头领打杀后，其他水鬼吓得四散逃离了。

    潜到洞底，陆川发现一个不大的石台。

    石台上有一个脸盆大小的贝壳，其上有一大把白的、黑的、粉的珍珠。

    一颗颗都有鹌鹑蛋大小，直晃人眼睛。

    陆川心中大喜，没想到居然还有意外收获。

    要是将这些珍珠都卖了，那小鱼的医药费也有着落了。

    三两下，陆川就将这些珍珠全都揣进衣服里面。

    再次游出洞穴，拉着水鬼头领的尸体游上了岸。

    “呼呼......”

    “今晚还真是大丰收啊！”

    陆江抹了把脸上的河水，一边兴奋道。

    这些水鬼身上的鳞片硬得惊人，寻常人就算用撬棍也很难弄下来。

    好在陆川刚学会了大力鹰爪功，一爪下去就能抓下一大片的鳞片。

    这些东西在黑市上能卖上不错的价钱。

    好在这边的码头晚上一直有水鬼传说，加上实在太晚根本就没人过来。

    这才让陆川能心无旁骛地处理水鬼。

    细小的鳞片被陆川无视，他只保留那些大片坚实无比的鳞片。

    没多久，他就收拾了一堆。

    寻常水鬼的鳞片有三百多片，水鬼头领的鳞片八十多片。

    还有水鬼头领那一对利爪也被陆川弄了下来。

    不过对于陆川来说，今晚最多的收获是那一堆珍珠。

    小鱼的药钱，终于有着落了。

    ......

    码头上的风满是腥味。

    天很快就亮了。

    今早赵扒皮并没有来，而是派了一个打手过来将两块大洋送了过来。

    打手的态度也是恭敬的不行，一路点头哈腰地叫着，‘陆爷您辛苦了。’

    陆川没搭理打手的态度，拿了大洋，抄起被他用麻袋装起来的水鬼鳞片转身就走。

    他没急着去黑市。

    黑市那都是半夜开的，现在去太早，也太太招摇。

    他得先回家，小鱼还在等着。

    回春堂的大门紧闭。
content_en:
"Plop!"

    Lu Chuan jumped into the Haihe River again.

    Because he was wearing the Water Ghost Bead, he only felt like a fish in the water.

    Not to mention holding your breath, the speed at which it is effective is amazingly fast.

    After a while, he dived deep into the water.

    After some searching, the body of the water ghost leader was soon found.

    Just when Lu Chuan was about to retrieve the body of the water ghost leader back to the shore, he accidentally discovered a faint halo of light on the bottom of the water in the distance.

    He swam over curiously and found a cave.

    The cave is wide, and there are many scratch marks and scales unique to water ghosts on it.

    Could it be that this is the home of the water ghosts?

    Lu Chuan suddenly became wary.

    Fortunately, no water ghost was found in the cave.

    It seems that after Lu Chuan killed the leader of the water ghosts, the other water ghosts were so frightened that they fled in all directions.

    Diving to the bottom of the cave, Lu Chuan found a small stone platform.

    There is a shell the size of a washbasin on the stone platform, with a large handful of white, black, and pink pearls on it.

    Each one is the size of a quail egg and dazzles people's eyes.

    Lu Chuan was overjoyed, but he didn't expect that there would be an unexpected gain.

    If all these pearls are sold, Xiaoyu's medical expenses will also be paid.

    In a few moments, Lu Chuan put all the pearls into his clothes.

    He swam out of the cave again and pulled the body of the water ghost leader to the shore.

    "Huhu..."

    “It’s really a bumper harvest tonight!”

    Lu Jiang wiped the river water from his face and said excitedly.

    The scales on these water ghosts are so hard that it is difficult for ordinary people to remove them even with a crowbar.

    Fortunately, Lu Chuan had just learned the powerful eagle claw skill, and he could grab a large scale with one claw.

    These items can fetch good prices on the black market.

    Fortunately, there are always legends of water ghosts at the pier here at night, and it was too late and no one came at all.

    This allowed Lu Chuan to concentrate on dealing with the water ghost.

    The small scales were ignored by Lu Chuan, and he only kept the large and solid scales.

    It didn't take long for him to clear up the pile.

    The average water ghost has more than 300 scales, and the leader of the water ghost has more than 80 scales.

    Lu Chuan also removed the pair of sharp claws of the leader of the water ghosts.

    But for Lu Chuan, the biggest gain tonight was the pile of pearls.

    Xiaoyu finally got his medicine money.

    ...

    The wind on the dock is full of fishy smell.

    Daylight soon dawned.

    Zhao Bapi did not come this morning, but sent a thug to deliver two pieces of ocean.

    The thug's attitude was also very respectful, nodding and bowing all the way, shouting, 'Master Lu, thank you for your hard work. ’

    Lu Chuan ignored the thug's attitude, took Dayang, picked up the water ghost scales he had packed in a sack, and turned around to leave.

    He was in no hurry to go to the black market.

    The black market always opens in the middle of the night. It's too early to go there and it's too ostentatious.

    He has to go home first, Xiaoyu is still waiting.

    The door of Huichun Hall is closed.
